images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation atlas on a genuinely transparent background, 1536×1024, EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal square cells, no grid lines. Draw a freestanding compact SQUARE heavy steel SAFE with depth, body width equal to body height, thick charcoal/slate-blue casing, broad warm ivory bevel around front door, ONE prominent round brass combination dial and a short sturdy handle, chunky left-edge hinges and visible retracting bolts. A solid appealing weighty silhouette, sparse purposeful detail. Camera almost frontal with a small right side visible, slightly above. This is a safe, not a top-opening chest, locker or a room door. Paint with opaque economical hand-painted color masses and a handful of broad directional strokes. Frame order row-major: (1) fully CLOSED; (2) still closed, brass dial turned, bolts retracting and subtle narrow amber seam; (3) front door cracks out by 10 degrees, vertical warm light gap on right; (4) thick front door swings LEFT outward to 55 degrees, lit internal compartment visible; (5) door swings fully LEFT to 110 degrees, behind and to the left of body, dramatic white-gold treasure light spilling from interior with a few broad rays and 3 bright star shapes; (6) door remains open at 110 degrees, calmer golden contents and a few suspended motes.
